purpose: Same-source validation confirmation of the relation-auxiliary-only MambaTSv3 candidate on one Weather success domain and the ETTh1 low-dimensional failure boundary.
research_question: Does AutoCon relation training without prediction-connected fusion remain competitive across Weather and ETTh1 H96 under an unchanged strong-baseline contract?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory matrix. Every job skips the test loader; no test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or test release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: This matrix can support cross-domain validation and explicit failure-boundary reporting only. It cannot establish held-out accuracy, universal AutoCon causality, or universal speed.

required_before_launch: verify ETTh1 and Weather fingerprints and exact 36-job expansion
freeze candidate, baseline, optimizer, normalization, and seed contracts
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job
create one immutable source snapshot and fresh output root

selection_contract.freeze_rule: The relation-auxiliary-only candidate, baseline set, split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, normalization, and seeds are fixed before launch; no test signal or dataset-specific retuning is allowed.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share chronological split, M features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epochs, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only MambaTSv3AutoCon receives AutoCon relation training with lambda=.001; prediction-connected fusion remains disabled.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: RLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer, and Mamba2 receive no AutoCon or candidate-only settings.

phases.name: baselines_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Same-source RLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer, and Mamba2 baselines.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report all paired Weather and ETTh1 cells, including failures; no held-out or causal claim.

stopping_rules: Keep ETTh1 as a mandatory failure-boundary cell even if Weather passes.
Do not promote any dataset to a held-out plan if the candidate is more than 2% worse than its strongest baseline.
Do not produce or inspect held-out artifacts.
prelaunch_gates: verify ETTh1 and Weather fingerprints and exact 36-job expansion
